Hi Priya,

Thank you for the conversation earlier. I appreciated you confirming the details on your team's current workload, specifically that six fee earners are spending around four hours each per week checking incoming packs.

As discussed, you will send ten anonymised sample packs by Friday. Once I receive them, I will return a bounded pilot outline along with our security questions within three business days.

I understand that any pilot will need approval from your managing partner before proceeding. I also want to confirm that no pricing was agreed during our call, and I have not assumed any figures on our end.

Please let me know if anything changes on your side regarding the sample packs or timing, and I will do the same if anything shifts with the pilot outline.

Looking forward to the next steps.

Best regards,
Idris

Deployment ahead of the October audit remains our target, and we'll keep working toward that timeline together.

Please let me know if anything above doesn't match your understanding, and I look forward to connecting again once the procurement call is scheduled.

Best regards,
Idris
